ground.stored_type: little-endian IEEE754 float32; native product bits preserved
ground.interpolation: Transform actual UTM world to lon/lat; piecewise actual-axis bilinear; no rectangularUTM substitute
ground.mean24h_policy: Query24 actual completed hourly means; before24h return null, never pad or repeat

aggregate.deposition_policy: Final cumulative snapshot, never sum cumulative snapshots

source_ppb.decode: C=scale*expm1(q/255*log_max); decode to scalar BEFORE spatial/time interpolation

initial_ppb.decode: C=scale*expm1(q/255*log_max); decode to scalar BEFORE spatial/time interpolation

display.quantization_error_includes: Q8 decoded throughFloat32 LUT then roundedHalfFloat
display.vertical: All16 actual native AGL layers retained; shader maps height-above-display-terrain to actual layer centers
display.quantization: Display only, no clipping cap; two8bitlog scalars decoded throughLUT toHalfFloatRG before GPU linear interpolation
display.projection: RegularUTM display regrid, native ground queries remain unchanged

time_policy: 360actual preceding hourly means; interpolate means at centers0.5..359.5h, hold first/last half-hour, report averaging window. Cumulative deposition uses hourly ends with known initial deposition0.
source_scope: Three outlet-origin selected-source increments only; background excluded. Not total ambient SO2

crest.role: Reused official UBC crest on existing geographically positioned terrain-following mesh

background_status: Deferred at user request; not part of current source increments
source_transport_model: Native3D outlet-origin + finite-density parameterized thermal rise
near_field_role: Fine trajectory-residence reconstruction, not resolved CFD or high-precision near-stack exposure; native ground queries unchanged by display reconstruction
